community_list_entries.name: Momento: Evaluating Persistent Memory and Reasoning with Multi-Session Agentic Conversations

phase1_classification.kind_reason: Benchmark of 161 multi-session, tool-mediated tasks on a restaurant service platform with 26 tools. It requires tracking evolving preferences, contradictory updates and temporal dependencies across sessions. The paper describes no coding tasks, and procedural memory is not a scored ability.
